title: Spicy Egg Frittata
description: A delicious vegetarian breakfast dish filled with spicy flavors.
instructions: Whisk eggs, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Set aside.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add chopped bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour whisked eggs over the vegetables and cook until the edges start to set.
Add diced jalapeno and shredded cheese, then stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
